newsitem.title: JAPAN: Okinawa refinery desulphuriser back on line Friday.
newsitem.headline: Okinawa refinery desulphuriser back on line Friday.

text.p: Refiner Okinawa Sekiyu Seisei Co Ltd said on Thursday that a 38,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) fuel oil desulphurisation unit at its 110,000 bpd plant on Japan's southern island of Okinawa would resume operations on Friday.
The refinery, closed after a fire in April, came back onstream in July, except for the desulphuriser, which cuts sulphur content in heavy fuel oil to 1.0 percent.
The restart of the unit would enable the plant to process Arabian Medium and Upper Zakum again, a company spokesman said.
It has mainly been processing Oman and Qatar Land since the accident.
